weakest-single.text:
To calculate two-thirds of 48, you can use the following formula:

\[ \text{two-thirds of } 48 = \frac{2}{3} \times 48 \]

\[ = 8 \times 48 \]

\[ = 384 \]

So, two-thirds of 48 is 384.

draft-raw.text:
To find two-thirds of 48, you multiply 48 by 2/3.

48 × 2/3 = 48 × 2 ÷ 3 = 96/3 = 32

So, two-thirds of 48 is 32.
